# Model specification: imu 1.0.0

Accelerometer and gyroscope chips on SPI as used by PX4 and ArduPilot (ICM-20689, ICM-42688-P, BMI055 accelerometer and gyroscope dies). Values come from the common sensor source (Hakoniwa sensor device or bench source).

## Features

| Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|
| base | Identity, reset, power, rate, temperature, data-ready. |
| accel | Accelerometer. |
| gyro | Gyroscope. |
| fifo | Sample FIFO. |

## Terms

| Term | Kind | Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| identity | status | base | Chip ID register value from the datasheet (ADV-CHIP-*-001). |
| reset | control | base | Soft reset: registers return to reset values. |
| power_mode | control | base | Sleep/normal per sensor; in sleep the data registers hold their last value. |
| accel_range | control | accel | Full scale of the accelerometer (e.g. ±2/4/8/16 g). |
| gyro_range | control | gyro | Full scale of the gyroscope (e.g. ±250..2000 dps). |
| output_rate | control | base | Output data rate; samples are produced at this rate. |
| filter_config | control | base | Digital low-pass/bandwidth settings: stored only. |
| accel_sample | data | accel | Three axes of acceleration as raw signed counts. |
| gyro_sample | data | gyro | Three axes of angular rate as raw signed counts. |
| temperature | data | base | Die temperature as raw counts (datasheet formula). |
| data_ready | status | base | A new sample is in the data registers. |
| data_ready_line | event | base | The chip's interrupt pin (Devicetree int-gpios). |
| int_config | control | base | Which condition drives data_ready_line, level/pulse, polarity. |
| fifo_enable | control | fifo | Samples are pushed to the chip FIFO. |
| fifo_count | status | fifo | Bytes (or samples) in the FIFO. |
| fifo_data | data | fifo | FIFO read port in the datasheet's packet format. |
| fifo_overflow | status | fifo | Samples were dropped because the FIFO was full. |
| fifo_reset | control | fifo | Empties the FIFO. |

## Behaviour rules

| Rule | Feature | Rule text |
|---|---|---|
| ADV-IMU-B001 | base | identity reads the datasheet chip ID at any time after power-up and after reset. |
| ADV-IMU-B002 | accel | An acceleration a (m/s², sensor frame) from the sensor source reads as raw = round(a / g0 x counts_per_g(accel_range)) per axis, saturated to the signed register width, in the datasheet's byte order, after the board's mount rotation (athrill,mount-rotation) is undone into the chip frame. |
| ADV-IMU-B003 | gyro | An angular rate w (rad/s) reads as raw = round(w x 180/pi x counts_per_dps(gyro_range)) per axis, saturated, byte order and axes as for ADV-IMU-B002. |
| ADV-IMU-B004 | base | A new sample is produced every 1 / output_rate of model time; data_ready turns on and data_ready_line follows int_config; reading the data (or the status, as the datasheet states) turns data_ready off. |
| ADV-IMU-B005 | fifo | With fifo_enable, each sample is appended to the FIFO in the datasheet's packet format; fifo_count counts what is stored; reading fifo_data returns packets in order; when full, new samples are dropped and fifo_overflow turns on (or the oldest are overwritten, as the datasheet states). |
| ADV-IMU-B006 | base | Multi-byte register reads auto-increment the register address as the datasheet states, so a burst returns all axes of one sample (no tearing between axes). |
| ADV-IMU-B007 | base | The SPI read protocol (read bit, dummy bytes where the datasheet requires them, e.g. none on BMI055) follows the datasheet. |

**Timing.** Samples are produced at output_rate in model time; the sensor source's sample at that time is used.

**Out of scope.** self-test, wake-on-motion, tap/step detection, offset registers other than as stored, I2C/I3C mode of these chips, noise and bias (Hakoniwa Drone's sensor models provide them in the source values)
